description_en: Queries the status of the audit log feature in the current region
description_zh: 查询当前地域下审计日志开通状态
kebab_example: aliyun hsm get-audit-log-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --get-oss-bucket true --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAuditLogStatus

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to obtain the list of OSS buckets that can be used to store audit logs. Valid values:

true

false
parameters.help_zh:
是否获取可用于存储审计日志的OSS Bucket列表。

true：是

false：否
parameters.name: get_oss_bucket

AuditLogStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the audit log feature is enabled. Valid values:

enable

disable
AuditLogStatus.description_zh:
审计日志开通状态。
enable：已开通 
disable：未开通

AuditOssBucket.description_en: The bucket that stores audit logs

GrantedServiceAccess.description_en:
Indicates whether Cloud Hardware Security Module is authorized to deliver logs. Valid values:

true

false
GrantedServiceAccess.description_zh:
是否授权加密服务投递日志。

true：已授权

false：未授权

OssBuckets.description_en: A list of buckets that can be used to store audit logs
OssBuckets.description_zh: 可用于存储审计日志的OSS Bucket列表

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。

true：成功

false：失败
